blocker1_doubleSerialization.rootCause: MessagePackEnvelope(MessageEnvelope) set IsMessageNativeMessagePackSerialized true unconditionally and re-serialized envelope.Message. When the source was itself a MessagePackEnvelope, already encoded bytes were wrapped a second time.
blocker1_doubleSerialization.repair: A MessagePack source carries its flag and payload bytes over unchanged; a foreign MessageEnvelope is converted as before. No deserialize-reserialize cycle. Content type and wire envelope unchanged.
blocker1_doubleSerialization.fixtureRestored: [TestFixture(typeof(MessagePackMessageSerializer))] on Redelivery_Specs; all three fixtures pass

blocker2_hardening.overlayPathCorrected: MessagePackMessageBodySerializer.OverrideMessage deserialized with no options at all and now uses the internal set
blocker2_hardening.assertionForm: The mode is asserted directly. UntrustedData and the default both bound graph depth; only hash collision resistance differs, so a behavioural test would be a timing experiment.
blocker2_hardening.friendAccess: tests/ViciOne.ServiceBus.Tests imports signing.props, as ViciOne.ServiceBus.RabbitMqTransport.Tests already does, because a signed assembly can only grant friendship to a signed one. Public surface unchanged.

blocker3_configuration.validationDefect: The matching check sat inside the IsNullOrWhiteSpace branch in both halves, so it only compared against an empty media type and a named but unregistered content type validated clean.
blocker3_configuration.configureCallbackNull: ConfigureJsonSerializerOptions assigned the callback result, including null, to the process wide options; it refuses null now.
blocker3_configuration.setMessageSerializerOptions: The Func result was discarded although the signature promises it is the options to use; a caller returning a new instance was silently ignored. The returned instance is used and null is refused.

semantic round trip asserted beside it

bodyLength.note: StringMessageBody was not named in the review and carried the same defect; corrected and declared.

formatterCaching.change: the formatter instance is a parameter of the compiled invoker rather than a captured constant, so one invoker serves every resolver and the cache is keyed by concrete type alone
formatterCaching.myFirstProofWasWrong: It counted cache entries. A variant that rebuilt on every call and overwrote the same key left the entry count at one and kept the test green. Compilations are counted now; the assertion is zero further compilations after warm up.

blocker4_resources.decimalAssertion: The document is parsed and exactly one property, its name, its String kind and its exact value are asserted; Does.Contain survived dropped camel casing.

blocker5_benchmarkOptions.sslServerName: Captured in the constructor where Host is still localhost and read only, so every TLS run would have presented localhost and validated a certificate against a name it was not talking to. It follows the effective host now, with an explicit --ssl-server-name override for a host given as an address.
blocker5_benchmarkOptions.portRange: outside 1..65535 refused at parse time with the range named
blocker5_benchmarkOptions.hostWithPort: refused at parse time naming --port; DNS, IPv4 and bracketed IPv6 host-only forms stay accepted
blocker5_benchmarkOptions.falseClaimCorrected: The comment claimed both orders of --port and --ssl were covered; only one was executed. The reverse order is now its own case.

brokerEvidence.optionOrder: --ssl=false before --port, the order that previously failed silently

mutation.probe: every send completion latency recorded as zero

remainingSleep.why: The assertion is equality of two timestamps, not a duration; the sleep only guarantees a wrong implementation would produce a different value.

processWideOptions.state: public static JsonSerializerOptions Options is a public mutable static field, not a property
processWideOptions.provenCostToday: tests/ViciOne.ServiceBus.Tests/Courier/DoubleActivity_Specs.cs:174 saves the options in Setup and restores them in Teardown so its converter does not leak into every other test. That restore duty is the proof the state is shared.
processWideOptions.recommendation: Freeze after first use with a loud refusal on later writes now; bind the options to the serializer instance as its own slice. Nothing implemented.

messagePackEnvelopeShape.state: ContractlessStandardResolverAllowPrivate; property names travel as string keys, no Key attributes on contracts
messagePackEnvelopeShape.effect: larger payload than integer keys, tolerant to reordering and added properties
messagePackEnvelopeShape.recommendation: Keep for this slice. Candidate for the serializer slice: integer keys for the envelope metadata only, which is an internal frame with a stable shape, leaving user contracts untouched. Nothing implemented.
